sources.citation: Mattei-Muller, Marie-Claude. 2003. Pémono: eslabón perdido entre mapoyo y yawarana, lenguas caribes ergativas de la Guayana noroccidental de Venezuela. Amerindia 28: 33-54.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: §2.1 Fonología (pp.37-44) covers consonants, vowels, syllable reduction only. p.43 explicitly defers: further analysis needed to determine 'el rol del acento tónico'. p.38 gives stress-marked phonetic forms (Pémono [tiʔˈpano] 'corto') and notes suffixation displaces the accent in Mapoyo ([ˈtëʔkena] ~ [tëhˈkena-ri] 'uno'). No rule for stress placement is stated.
